verdict.rationale: Supabase documents a Management API to create and manage organizations and projects programmatically, backed by a live OpenAPI spec. It also offers branching that spins off isolated preview environments per pull request. Together these cover programmatic fleet management and per-preview isolation. Nothing in the evidence shows that databases are cheap to create, that thousands can be provisioned, or that per-agent or per-tenant database-per-entity patterns are supported. Missing for 10: evidence of low per-database cost, scale to thousands of databases, a per-agent/tenant provisioning workflow, and independent corroboration.
